einzeiler: Carol Burnett and Rae share hilarious behind-the-scenes stories from their acting careers.
kurzfassung: Carol Burnett and Rae swap entertaining behind-the-scenes anecdotes from their television, film, and theater work. They discuss awkward fan encounters, disastrous auditions, and surreal moments with Hollywood legends. The conversation highlights the absurd realities and unexpected challenges of a life in show business.
stichpunkte: Carol Burnett recounts being so starstruck meeting her childhood idol Jimmy Stewart that she immediately tripped into a bucket of whitewash.
Rae describes accidentally stripping off her wardrobe during a multicam sitcom pilot because she mistakenly believed they would not cut between scenes.
Rae shares a humiliating audition story where severe nervousness led her to jokingly tell Rob Morrow that they had slept together.
Carol recalls the time a New York department store employee would only accept her check if she performed a Tarzan yell.
Rae explains how severe lighting on a boardwalk shoot revealed a backlit blonde peach fuzz mustache that required emergency facial waxing.
Carol shares a story about Walter Matthau pulling her aside on her first film to playfully mock the speed of television production.
Carol recounts being recognized on an airplane while watching her own poorly reviewed movie and apologizing to all the passengers over the intercom.

clips.hook: A childhood idol encounter leads straight into a bucket.
clips.text: After finally meeting her favorite actor on a studio lot, a wave of nervousness causes a bizarre verbal slip followed immediately by a clumsy retreat into painting supplies.

clips.hook: Stripping behind the scenes of a sitcom pilot.
clips.text: Believing a television scene would be filmed continuously like a stage play, an actor frantically tears off her clothes in the hallway while network executives watch on monitors.

clips.hook: Apologizing to an entire airplane over the intercom.
clips.text: Trapped on a flight showing a movie she hated her performance in, an actress takes over the public address system to apologize to every passenger.

clips.hook: Sabotaging a major chemistry read with a bizarre joke.
clips.text: Paralyzed by extreme anxiety during a final audition with a famous lead actor, an actor panics and responds to a polite greeting with an absurd fabrication about their past.

clips.hook: Comparing the speed of movies versus television.
clips.text: During a lunch break on a film set, a veteran movie star attempts to intimidate a television actor by asking why she works in such lowbrow media.

beschreibung:
Meet two of Vince Gilligan’s favorite storytellers in this special bonus episode! Rhea Seehorn and Carol Burnett come together to trade tales of day jobs and quick changes, and they reveal just how mortifying auditions can get.
